title: Source definitions
description: A pointer to the external machine-readable file that owns information that DSDS only documents around (a DTCG token file, a Custom Elements Manifest, or an equivalent). Shared by `token`/`tokenGroup`/`theme` `source` and `api` block members. DSDS never copies the fact itself; it copies the pointer, so the fact cannot fork between the two files.

source.description: Where the information this entity or member documents lives. DSDS doesn't validate the target file's content, only that this pointer is well-formed. `file` is required; `path` narrows the pointer to one location within it, when the file holds more than one relevant fact.

file.description: URI or relative path to the external file (ex: a DTCG token file, a `custom-elements.json` manifest).

path.description: A locator for one fact within `file`, when the file holds more than one. Format follows the target file's own addressing convention: a dot-path for a DTCG token tree (ex: 'color.action.primary'), a JSON Pointer or manifest-specific path for a CEM manifest (ex: 'MyElement.disabled'). Not validated by DSDS (it's a hint for tooling that reads the target file.)
